text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking a stroll through the forest,
when...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heh. I've finally found it! The
phantom
mushroom that grows only in
this forest!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Oh, here, I brought a
bag for
you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, uh, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And here are some wet tissues! You can
clean the
dirt off your hands with these.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...My, what a wonderful little assistant
you are.
But is there a reason you've
followed me all the
way here?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well, I saw you walking around campus,
and you
looked tired and a little out of
it, so...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I thought maybe there was something I
could do
to help... Am I getting in your
way?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. In fact, I'm grateful you're
here! I
should give you something as
thanks.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Please, you don't need to do anything
like that!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Modesty may be a virtue, but restraint is
not...
You want to become an
independent adult, don't
you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? How did you know that?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Perfect. Then I'll make you a
special
concoction from this mushroom.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It will enhance the growth hormones
secreted
during sleep, thus helping you
become an adult
faster.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... that sounds very complicated,
but... I'm not
sure if it's exactly what I'm
looking for...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A healthy body is key to a healthy
mind... Why
not try starting with the
body first?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, okay!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... What terrible timing for a call.
Hello?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...The student council has received an
anonymous tip, and they're going to
conduct an inspection of
my lab? This is
not good.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Yep. Well, that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sky? What brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, fancy running into you here, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was just taking a nap in a field nearby.
Wanna
head back together?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Uh, sure!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Sky was on the phone just now...
but who
could she have been calling out
here in the
middle of the forest?
